page.overview:
Who is Harlot?

The Harlot is a character created by American comic book creator Michael Alan Nelson for the Boom! Studios Mythos series Fall of Cthulhu. She made her debut appearance in the very first issue in 2007.

The Harlot is a large humanoid creature who dresses in a gaudy burlesque style offset by her appearance, which appears to be degenerate to the point of resembling a corpse. A resident of the Dreamlands, she operates a brothel of sorts, trading her secrets for less savoury payments, such as body parts or memories.

The Harlot is a powerful creature in control of her own dream-realm, and has been seen to destroy several Nightgaunts with little effort. Although she is not a match for a being such as the Elder God Nodens, she has stated that she would be capable of making him work for his victory, should such a confrontation come about.

The Harlot chose to help the bereaved dreamer Cy Morgan, even to the point of challenging the Elder God Nodens for the possession of him. She later imprisoned him in one of her boxes at his own request, as he wished to forget the death of his fiancé, which he believed to have been his own fault (: Fall of Cthulhu Volume 1: The Fugue).
